name: Do Things that Don't Scale
summary: Paul Graham's July 2013 essay: startups take off only when founders push them, from manual recruiting to early fragility.
description: Paul Graham's essay of July 2013 on the advice Y Combinator gives founders: startups take off because the founders make them take off. It covers recruiting users manually (Stripe's aggressive early user acquisition and the 'Collison installation'; Airbnb going door to door in New York) and the fragility of very early startups, plus measuring progress by weekly growth rate.
contains: essay sections include Recruit and Fragile
examples: Stripe's Collison installation, Airbnb's door-to-door start
advice from Y Combinator to founders
